title: IBM App Connect Enterprise 13.0.1.0 through 13.0.8.2 could allow a remote attacker to perform unauthorized actions due…
description: IBM App Connect Enterprise versions 13.0.1.0 through 13.0.8.2 have a vulnerability related to missing anti-clickjacking controls. This flaw could allow a remote attacker to perform unauthorized actions via clickjacking techniques. The vulnerability has a low severity score and does not impact confidentiality or availability but may cause limited integrity issues.
